shortDescription: Module for setup of Cloud Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: autoscale_polling_interval
options.description: Cloudconnector polling interval in seconds for external autoscale groups, minimum 60 seconds. Allowed values are 60-3600. Field introduced in 18.2.2. Unit is seconds. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 60), basic (allowed values- 60) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: aws_configuration
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: azure_configuration
options.description: Field introduced in 17.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: cloudstack_configuration
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: custom_tags
options.description: Custom tags for all avi created resources in the cloud infrastructure. Field introduced in 17.1.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: dhcp_enabled
options.description: Select the ip address management scheme. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: disable_metrics_polling
options.description: To disable metrics collection. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: dns_provider_ref
options.description: Dns profile for the cloud. It is a reference to an object of type ipamdnsproviderprofile. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: dns_resolution_on_se
options.description: By default, pool member fqdns are resolved on the controller. When this is set, pool member fqdns are instead resolved on service engines in this cloud. This is useful in scenarios where pool member fqdns can only be resolved from service engines and not from the controller. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- false), basic (allowed values- false) edition. Default value when not specified

options.name: dns_resolvers
options.description: Dns resolver for the cloud. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Maximum of 1 items allowed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: docker_configuration
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: east_west_dns_provider_ref
options.description: Dns profile for east-west services. It is a reference to an object of type ipamdnsproviderprofile. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: east_west_ipam_provider_ref
options.description: Ipam profile for east-west services. Warning - please use virtual subnets in this ipam profile that do not conflict with the underlay networks or any overlay networks in the cluster. For example in aws and gcp, 169.254.0.0/16 is used for storing instance metadata. Hence, it should not be used in this profile. It is a reference to an object of type ipamdnsproviderprofile. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: enable_vip_on_all_interfaces
options.description: Enable vip on all data interfaces for the cloud. Field introduced in 18.2.9, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: enable_vip_static_routes
options.description: Use static routes for vip side network resolution during virtualservice placement. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: gcp_configuration
options.description: Google cloud platform configuration. Field introduced in 18.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ip6_autocfg_enabled
options.description: Enable ipv6 auto configuration. Field introduced in 18.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: ipam_provider_ref
options.description: Ipam profile for the cloud. It is a reference to an object of type ipamdnsproviderprofile. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: license_tier
options.description: Specifies the default license tier which would be used by new se groups. This field by default inherits the value from system configuration. Enum options - ENTERPRISE_16, ENTERPRISE, ENTERPRISE_18, BASIC, ESSENTIALS, ENTERPRISE_WITH_CLOUD_SERVICES. Field introduced in 17.2.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: license_type
options.description: If no license type is specified then default license enforcement for the cloud type is chosen. The default mappings are container cloud is max ses, openstack and vmware is cores and linux it is sockets. Enum options - LIC_BACKEND_SERVERS, LIC_SOCKETS, LIC_CORES, LIC_HOSTS, LIC_SE_BANDWIDTH, LIC_METERED_SE_BANDWIDTH. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: linuxserver_configuration
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: maintenance_mode
options.description: Cloud is in maintenance mode. Field introduced in 20.1.7,21.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: markers
options.description: List of labels to be used for granular rbac. Field introduced in 22.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: metrics_polling_interval
options.description: Cloud metrics collector polling interval in seconds. Field introduced in 22.1.1. Unit is seconds. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 300.

options.name: mgmt_ip_v4_enabled
options.description: Enable ipv4 on the management interface of the serviceengine. Defaults to dhcp if no static config on network present. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: mgmt_ip_v6_enabled
options.description: Enable ipv6 on the management interface of the serviceengine. Defaults to autocfg if no static config on network present. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: mtu
options.description: Mtu setting for the cloud. Unit is bytes. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1500.

options.name: name
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: nsxt_configuration
options.description: Nsx-t cloud platform configuration. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ntp_configuration
options.description: Ntp configuration for the cloud. Field introduced in 22.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: obj_name_prefix
options.description: Default prefix for all automatically created objects in this cloud. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: prefer_static_routes
options.description: Prefer static routes over interface routes during virtualservice placement. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: proxy_configuration
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: rancher_configuration
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: resolve_fqdn_to_ipv6
options.description: Resolve ipv6 address for pool member fqdns. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: se_group_template_ref
options.description: The service engine group to use as template. It is a reference to an object of type serviceenginegroup. Field introduced in 18.2.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: state_based_dns_registration
options.description: Dns records for vips are added/deleted based on the operational state of the vips. Field introduced in 17.1.12. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- true), basic (allowed values- true) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: vca_configuration
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: vcenter_configuration
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: vmc_deployment
options.description: This deployment is vmware on aws cloud. Field introduced in 20.1.5, 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: vtype
options.description: Cloud type. Enum options - CLOUD_NONE, CLOUD_VCENTER, CLOUD_OPENSTACK, CLOUD_AWS, CLOUD_VCA, CLOUD_APIC, CLOUD_MESOS, CLOUD_LINUXSERVER, CLOUD_DOCKER_UCP, CLOUD_RANCHER, CLOUD_OSHIFT_K8S, CLOUD_AZURE, CLOUD_GCP, CLOUD_NSXT. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- cloud_none, cloud_vcenter), basic (allowed values- cloud_none, cloud_nsxt) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Con
